hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street can hide pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the block.

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs visible, forcing pedestrians to cross at unmarked locations.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left side is narrow and directly adjacent to building walls and the roadway, providing little room for error or passing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians and no visual warning for drivers to expect crossing activity.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The visible corners appear to have standard vertical curbs without sloped transitions, creating a barrier for users with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a relatively wide street can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds near the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: The main roadway stretching from the foreground into the distance.

hazards.name: Lack of permanent buffer
hazards.description: The separation between the sidewalk and the roadway relies entirely on parked vehicles, with no permanent physical barriers like trees or bollards.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line behind the parked car

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both curbs block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street where cars are parked.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Continuous Path
interventions.description: Construct a wide, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Parking Management and Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement clear parking regulations and physical barriers to prevent vehicles from obstructing the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Lighting and Greening
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting and street trees to improve visibility, safety, and the overall walking environment.

interventions.title: Install Paved Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide dedicated pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and security at night.

interventions.title: Pavement Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repave the roadway to provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Protection
interventions.description: Install bollards or high curbs to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Designated Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Paint or physically separate a walkway to provide a safe space for pedestrians away from vehicle loading areas.

interventions.title: Enhanced Lighting
interventions.description: Install street or building-mounted lighting to improve visibility during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked surfaces and regularly clear debris to ensure a stable walking surface.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement off-sidewalk trash storage solutions or enclosures to ensure the full width of the walkway remains clear for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and parked/moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate potholes and uneven patches.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Remove large storage containers or temporary structures from the public right-of-way to restore sightlines and walkway access.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Clearance
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalks and implement stricter parking enforcement to ensure the walkway remains clear of vehicle encroachment.

interventions.title: Streetscape Enhancements
interventions.description: Introduce street trees and improved lighting to enhance the safety and comfort of the pedestrian realm.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and, if possible, widen the sidewalk to meet ADA standards and accommodate obstructions like trash cans.

interventions.title: Waste Management Zones
interventions.description: Designate specific on-street or off-sidewalk areas for trash collection to keep the pedestrian clear zone unobstructed.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repave the broken sections of the sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible surface for all users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety, especially given the blank frontages.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Complete repaving and leveling of the sidewalk on the left side to ensure a continuous, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the far intersection to improve visibility for pedestrians attempting to cross.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds on this residential block.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at the nearest intersections to provide pedestrians with a designated and visible crossing path.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the sidewalk to provide more space for pedestrians and accommodate utilities or trash bins without blocking the path.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety after dark.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip with street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the corners to reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install two curb ramps per corner with detectable warning surfaces to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install vertical deflection measures to slow vehicle speeds in this residential/mixed-use context.
